description: bot2bot.poll has THREE divergences from REQ-B2. (1) Spec: 'fetch open bot2bot-* issues' — implementation hardcodes label 'bot2bot-review-requested' and never queries other bot2bot-* kinds (opinion-requested, escalation, pr-mentioned). (2) Spec: 'authored by an anicca-bot account' — implementation never filters by author. (3) Spec accepts a slot argument but the implementation ignores it; issues from all slots flow through. PROP-B2 test test_poll_returns_empty_list_when_no_issues is tautological — '[]' input → [] output. The actual schema mapping (issue_url/kind/slot/body/ts_created vs spec {issue_url, comment_body, kind, ts}) also diverges (body vs comment_body; ts_created vs ts).

evidence.snippet:
def poll(*, slot: str) -> list[dict]:
    """REQ-B2: fetch open bot2bot-* issues; empty list if none. NEVER crashes."""
    out = _gh_call("issue", "list", "--label", f"bot2bot-review-requested",
                   "--state", "open", "--json", "url,title,body,createdAt")
